WFAM.Title: WFRP 4e Automated Miscasts
WFAM.Settings.Enabled.Name: Post miscasts as draggable cards
WFAM.Settings.Enabled.Hint: When a miscast table is rolled (from a casting or channelling card, an @Table link or /table), post a miscast card. Results with automation can be dragged onto a character sheet or token to apply them as a temporary effect; narrative results are a plain card. Turn off for the system's plain text result.
WFAM.Card.DragHint: Drag this card onto a character sheet or token to apply the miscast as a temporary effect.
WFAM.Effect.NoCastingToast: You cannot cast or channel spells right now.
WFAM.Card.DragHintArea: Drag this card onto the canvas (or the caster's sheet) to place the miscast's area.
WFAM.Drop.AreaNeedsCanvas: This miscast affects an area: drag it onto the canvas, or give the caster a token on the scene.
WFAM.Drop.NoActor: Drop the miscast onto a character sheet or a token.
WFAM.Forget.Title: Forgetfulness: {actor}
WFAM.Forget.Prompt: The spell is lost to your memory. Choose the memorised spell to un-memorise:
WFAM.Effect.LashTurn: Major Miscast at start of turn
WFAM.Select.Title: Manually Select Miscast
WFAM.Select.Hint: For testing: post the card for a specific result, exactly as if it had been rolled.
WFAM.Select.GMOnly: Only the GM can use Manually Select Miscast.
WFAM.Select.NoTables: No miscast tables are installed (Core Rulebook, Winds of Magic or Moo's Homebrew).
WFAM.Effect.Choice: Choose: spend Fate or be lost
WFAM.Choice.Title: Miscast: choose
WFAM.Choice.NoAnswer: {source}: {actor} didn't choose an outcome (prompt closed or timed out), so nothing was applied. Resolve it by hand.
WFAM.Void.Prompt: You are being dragged into the Realm of Chaos. Spend a Fate point to escape (you gain 1 Corruption and 1 Stunned Condition), or be lost forever. Fate points: {fate}.
WFAM.Void.PromptNoFate: You are being dragged into the Realm of Chaos and have no Fate points to spend. You will be lost forever.
WFAM.Void.SpentFate: {actor} spends a Fate point to escape the Void: +1 Corruption and Stunned.
WFAM.Void.WasLost: {actor} is lost to the Realm of Chaos.
WFAM.Limb.Applied: {location} is useless: {injury} applied. It is removed when this effect ends.
WFAM.Limb.NoInjury: {name} ({location}): no system injury matches this location, so nothing was added. Resolve it by hand.
WFAM.Patch.SoulpyreEnds: Remove Stunned when the Soulpyre ends
WFAM.Limb.WitherHead: {name} ({location}): the eyes and mouth fuse shut. The mouth can be cut open, but vision is lost forever. No system injury covers this, so nothing was added. Resolve it by hand.
